summary: Frontend-only verification of three new roof-sketch features on lead d0df5baa (rev 422ea69c). (2) SITE PLAN FIDELITY — Attached Garage renders flush against the House (no gap) and shares the common bottom baseline; House is the largest/leftmost anchor and Front Covered Porch is drawn overlaid within the House footprint band (bottom-aligned, flush). Low-priority per request. No console errors beyond two benign 404s for static assets.

issues: Front Covered Porch is drawn overlapping/inside the House outline rather than beside it. Since porch is attached and small, this appears intended by the flush+bottom-aligned rule (porch stacks against the previous attached structure), but visually the porch label sits inside House footprint which can be confusing. Consider adding minimal Z-order tinting or a subtle outline to differentiate attached-overlap-attached scenarios.
